entity.description: An employer's pay component: a stable code (a formula's name for its result, unique in the employer), a name, and its kind, an earning, a deduction, an employer contribution or a statistical value (which enters no total and posts nothing). Its calculation is in its dated terms. Ended (thruDate), never deleted, once it is no longer used.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: componentCode
field.description: A name a formula may use: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits and underscores

field.name: componentKindEnumId
field.description: PayrollComponentKind

entity.description: A component's dated calculation, from fromDate until thruDate: a fixed amount or a formula (the framework's decimal expression: named decimal inputs, the codes of other components, comparisons, conditions and an allowlist of functions, nothing else) over its declared inputs (inputNames) and the components it depends on (dependencyCodes, the names it reads that are not inputs); the currency of a money component (required: no implicit currency) or the unit of a statistical one; its rounding stage (places and direction; none keeps the precision); whether a payslip shows it; and its account mapping (the expense account of an earning or contribution, the liability account of a deduction or contribution; a statistical component maps none). A draft is changed until it is published, with examples that verify it; a published term is ended, never changed, and published intervals of one component do not overlap.

field.name: statusId
field.description: PayrollTerm: draft or published

field.name: basisEnumId
field.description: PayrollComponentBasis

field.name: amount
field.description: A fixed amount's value

field.name: inputNames
field.description: The declared inputs, comma separated

field.name: dependencyCodes
field.description: The codes of the components the formula reads, comma separated; computed when the term is stored

field.name: quantityUomId
field.description: A statistical component's unit, when it has one

field.name: roundingEnumId
field.description: PayrollRounding

field.name: prorated
field.description: A fixed amount's proration (impl-people P25 review, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026): Y, a pay run multiplies it by the period fraction in a part period (a mid-period hire or leaver, a split period's segments); N, it is paid whole. Set when the term is stored: yes for an earning, a deduction and an employer contribution unless payroll says otherwise, no for a statistical value; empty for a formula, which reads periodFraction to prorate. Empty on a fixed amount stored before it reads by the same kind default.

field.name: publishedDate
field.description: When it was published: its approval's (impl-people P22 review)

field.name: publishedByUserId
field.description: Who asked to publish it

field.name: draftedByUserIds
field.description: Each user who changed the draft or its examples, comma separated: none of them decides its publishing (impl-people P22 review)

entity.description: A named example of a component's term: the value of each name its formula reads (inputValues, a JSON object of decimal texts) and the amount expected. Preview computes each one; a term is published only when every example gives its expected amount. Configuration values, read and written by payroll configuration alone.

An employer's reusable pay calculation: a name, one currency (every money component of it is in it), a pay basis, and its components (PayrollStructureComponent). A draft until it is first published, from fromDate; published lines are only ended; ended (thruDate) when no longer used. A copy is a new structure with draft lines and no assignments. Publishing reassigns no employee and rewrites no payslip.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: payBasisEnumId
field.description: PayrollPayBasis

field.name: statusId
field.description: PayrollTerm: draft until first published

field.name: publishedDate
field.description: When its draft lines were last published: their approval's

field.name: publishedByUserId
field.description: Who last asked to publish its draft lines

field.name: draftedByUserIds
field.description: Each user who changed the structure or its lines since it was last published, comma separated: none of them decides its publishing (impl-people P22 review)

entity.description: A component of a structure from fromDate (the structure's publishing date when empty) until thruDate: its payslip order (sequenceNum, independent of the calculation order its dependencies decide) and the structure's values of the component's declared inputs (parameterValues, a JSON object of decimal texts, such as a contribution's rate). A draft until the structure is published; a published line is only ended.

field.name: eligibilityEnumId
field.description: PayrollLineEligibility: every assignment of the structure (empty or PleAll), or only an assignment that elects the component (PleElected, such as a voluntary pension); impl-people P23

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Only when the assignment elects it

entity.description: An employer's pay group: its currency (a run is one employer and currency), its pay frequency (a Payroll time period type) and the first day of its first period, its explicit periods a year (the annual divisor a salary formula reads; never assumed), the pay date's place (days after a period's last day), how a part period is prorated (calendar days, working days or hours) and where hours come from, the time zone of its workweek, and the localization it is bound to. liveEnabled is N in this build: no localization covers a group (the demonstration one never can) and the payroll-origin projection is not built, so a group is preview only (design §8). Its policy fields are audited.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: prorationEnumId
field.description: PayrollProration

field.name: timeBasisEnumId
field.description: PayrollTimeBasis

entity.description: A pay period of a group: Mantle's TimePeriod of the employer and the group's frequency (shared by the employer's groups of that frequency and start) with the group's pay date. Prepared once, idempotently; a period is never closed merely to mark a run finished.

A payroll localization's registration (design §8.4, PE-12): its jurisdictions, the effective coverage of its rule set and its release, the setup it requires, its outputs, and its calculation service, which implements mantle.humanres.PayrollLocalizationServices.calculate#Localization (side-effect free: declared pay facts and bases in, itemized employee and employer amounts, explanations and findings out). Trusted deployed code registered as seed data, never named in a payroll form. A demonstration localization (isDemonstration Y) previews examples and is never live; this build ships that one alone (impl-people §4, Nov 11, 2026).

mantle.humanres.payroll.PayrollLocalizat.description: A flat demonstration levy on earnings (2% from the employee, 1% from the employer) to show where a localization's amounts enter gross to net. It is no country's law, previews only, and can never make a pay group live.

entity.description: A field a localization declares for an employment's payroll tax profile (design §8.1 PayrollTaxProfile, §8 PayAssignments' TaxAndBenefits; impl-people P23): its name, its label, its kind (an indicator, a choice of listed values, a decimal or a short text), the values a choice offers ("value = label" pairs, one a line), and whether it is required before the localization can calculate for the employment. A profile holds values of these fields alone: the fields of the localizations installed, never a country's columns in the neutral core. Seed data beside its localization.

field.name: fieldName
field.description: A name a localization's calculation reads: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits and underscores

field.name: fieldKindEnumId
field.description: PayrollProfileFieldKind

field.name: optionValues
field.description: A choice's values, "value = label", one a line

mantle.humanres.payroll.PayrollLocalizat.description: A synthetic region, to show a required election; it changes no amount
A synthetic exemption, to show an optional election; it changes no amount

entity.description: An employment's dated pay terms (design §8.1 PayrollAssignment, §8 PayAssignments; PE-08; impl-people P23): the structure it is calculated with and the pay group it is paid in (both its employer's, in one currency), from fromDate until thruDate, the values of its structure's declared inputs that are the employment's own (inputValues, a JSON object of decimal texts), and the components of elective lines it takes (electedComponentIds). EmploymentSalary stays the salary and RateAmount the hourly rate: an assignment refers to them and keeps no salary of its own, and assigning a structure changes no salary. One primary assignment (isPrimary Y) applies per employment and date across every group; another earning source is a component or an input, or a secondary assignment of another structure. Ended (thruDate, audited with its reason), never deleted.

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: The employment

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: thruDate
field.description: Audited from its first value (an end is the change; "update" would skip it), with its reason (P23 review)

field.name: electedComponentIds
field.description: The components of elective lines (PleElected) the assignment takes, comma separated

field.name: operationKey
field.description: The assigner's key: a retry with it answers the first

entity.description: An employment's payroll tax profile for a localization from fromDate until thruDate (design §8.1 PayrollTaxProfile, §8 PayAssignments' TaxAndBenefits; PE-12; impl-people P23): the values of the fields the localization declares (profileValues, a JSON object; PayrollLocalizationField), so the neutral core holds no country's columns. A change starts a new profile and ends the one in effect (thruDate audited with its reason); never deleted. Employment's and Employee's historical US tax fields are neither read nor written (impl-people F33). Bank details are not here: they are the person's payment methods, changed through Accounting's payment-method services.

field.name: thruDate
field.description: Audited from its first value (an end is the change; "update" would skip it), with its reason (P23 review)

entity.description: An approved (or, for an adjustment, proposed) pay input of an employment for a pay group's period: its kind (PayrollInputType), the day or date it is for (inputDate), the formula input it supplies (inputName: workedHours, paidLeaveHours, unpaidLeaveHours, pieces, reimbursement) or the component an adjustment is to (payrollComponentId), a quantity with its unit or an amount with its currency (never assumed), the source's own rate where it has one (rateAmount: a time entry's worker rate, evidence for the calculation), its state (PayrollInput status: proposed, approved, refused, voided, finalized) and the entitlement it pays (entitlementKey; activeEntitlementKey while it is neither voided nor refused, unique). An adjustment carries its reason and evidence, the inputs of one recurrence share seriesInputId, and a correction of a finalized input links it (correctionOfInputId). Created, approved and voided by PayrollInputServices; finalized by the pay run's finalization, after which it is never changed.

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: The employment

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: timePeriodId
field.description: The group's pay period it is for

field.name: inputTypeEnumId
field.description: PayrollInputType

field.name: inputName
field.description: The formula input it supplies, for an input of time, pieces or a reimbursement

field.name: payrollComponentId
field.description: The component an adjustment is to

field.name: inputDate
field.description: The day it is for (an adjustment's date)

field.name: rateAmount
field.description: The source's own rate (a time entry's worker rate), kept as evidence

field.name: statusId
field.description: PayrollInput: PinProposed, PinApproved, PinRefused, PinVoided, PinFinalized

field.name: activeEntitlementKey
field.description: The entitlementKey while the input is neither voided nor refused; unique, so an entitlement is paid once

field.name: isAdjustment
field.description: Y: made by store#Adjustment (approved by a payroll approver), not prepared from a source

field.name: reason
field.description: An adjustment's reason, a payroll working note

field.name: evidence
field.description: An adjustment's evidence: what it rests on

field.name: seriesInputId
field.description: The first input of a recurring adjustment, which every input of the recurrence names

field.name: correctionOfInputId
field.description: The finalized input a correction changes

field.name: operationKey

field.name: changedByUserIds
field.description: Each user who made or changed an adjustment, comma separated: none of them decides it

field.name: payrollRunId
field.description: The pay run whose calculation took the input (impl-people P25): another run does not take it while that run is live, and a change of it invalidates that run's approval

entity.description: A source record a pay input consumed (design §8.1 PayrollInputSource): a time entry (its hours or its pieces), an attendance day, a day of a leave request, an expense claim, or the advance an adjustment recovers; its part (quantity or amount), the source's fingerprint when it was prepared (sourceRevision: its hours, rates, minutes or state, so a change since is seen) and its key (sourceKey; activeSourceKey while its input is neither voided nor refused, unique, so a source is consumed once). Mantle's time writers read it: a worker invoice refuses a time entry a pay input consumed, and a change of a consumed entry or the reopening of its week voids an input not finalized and is refused for a finalized one.

field.name: sourcePart
field.description: The part of the source: hours or pieces of a time entry, the day of a leave request

entity.description: A pay run of a pay group for one of its prepared periods: the employer and currency (the group's), the pay date, its kind (regular, off-cycle, correction), the source cutoff, its state (draft, calculating, review, approved, and P27's finalizing and finalized; cancelled), who prepared it (selected or calculated: none of them approves it) and the approval it took (approvedRevision: the population, amounts and sources approved). A group's period has one live regular run (activeRunKey, unique), so its inputs are not paid twice.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: runKindEnumId
field.description: PayrollRunKind

field.name: statusId
field.description: PayrollRun

field.name: activeRunKey
field.description: group:period:kind of a live regular run; unique

field.name: preparedByUserIds
field.description: Each user who selected the population or calculated, comma separated: none of them approves the run

field.name: approvedRevision
field.description: The revision the approval was made at

field.name: returnedReason
field.description: Why the approver returned it, when they did

field.name: cancelReason
field.description: Why a payroll editor cancelled it (cancel#Run, a run not approved; impl-people P25 review): its inputs released and its activeRunKey freed

field.name: correctsPayslipId
field.description: A correction run's original slip (impl-people P26, create#Correction): the run recalculates that slip's employment and pays the change

field.name: correctionReason
field.description: Why the slip is corrected (the changed source or rule)

entity.description: An employment of a run's population, its own unit of work: pending (selected, not calculated yet or changed since), calculated, in error (its reason code and message persisted, the other units going on) or excluded (with the reason, its totals kept out but the exclusion shown in the approval); the primary pay assignment and structure it was calculated with, its totals (gross, deductions, employer contributions, the localization's employee and employer amounts, net, employer cost), how its period was split (salary, rate or assignment changes), the fingerprint of the sources and rules its results were calculated from (sourceRevision: a change since makes the results stale and the approval invalid), and the attempts made. One a run and employment.

field.name: statusId
field.description: PayrollRunUnit

field.name: splitText
field.description: How the period was split and prorated

entity.description: A draft result line of a run's employment: a component's amount for the period (its segments summed or taken once, its adjustments added, rounded to the currency; a statistical value in its unit, entering no total) or a localization's item (employee or employer), with its explanation (each segment's formula and values, the rounding). Replaced when the employment is calculated again; P26's payslips and P27's finalization make the lasting facts.

field.name: localizationParty
field.description: employee or employer, for a localization's item

field.name: previousAmount
field.description: A correction run's line: what the original slip and the corrections before it paid (impl-people P26); its amount is the change

field.name: payrollComponentTermId
field.description: The component term the line was calculated by (impl-people P26: a payslip line names its rule); none for a localization's item or an adjustment of a component outside the structure

entity.description: A pay result of one employment of an approved pay run, with its own identity: the employer, the employment and person, the group, period, pay date, currency and the run's kind; its totals (gross, deductions, employer contributions, the localization's employee and employer amounts, net, employer cost) and how its period was split; the fingerprint of the sources it came from (sourceRevision). Its state: a preview (preview mode: payroll's alone, never issued), withdrawn (its run's approval was taken back before it was approved again), final (P27's finalization) or issued (its statement rendered once and stored, the person told). A correction names the slip it corrects (correctsPayslipId, the original: its lines and totals are the change, and the original stays). One slip a run's employment.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The employer

field.name: runKindEnumId
field.description: PayrollRunKind: regular, off-cycle or correction

field.name: correctsPayslipId
field.description: The original slip a correction corrects

field.name: statusId
field.description: Payslip

field.name: isPreview
field.description: Y for a preview slip (preview mode): never issued as pay

field.name: sourceRevision
field.description: The fingerprint of the sources and rules the slip came from (the run employment's when its run was approved)

field.name: approvedDate
field.description: When its run was approved for these results

field.name: contentLocation
field.description: The issued statement, rendered once and stored (its PDF, or its html-print page where the server has no PDF engine)

entity.description: A line of a payslip: a component's amount (an earning, a deduction, an employer contribution; a statistical value in its unit, in no total) or a localization's item (employee or employer), the term it was calculated by (payrollComponentTermId, the dated rule) and its explanation (each part's formula and values, the adjustments, the rounding). On a correction slip the amount is the change and previousAmount what the original and the corrections before it paid. payslipVisible N (the term's setting) keeps a line from the person's own view, never from the totals.

field.name: localizationParty
field.description: employee or employer, for a localization's item

field.name: previousAmount
field.description: On a correction slip: the line as paid before

entity.description: A file of a payslip (IronStone People PE-01, the payslip content host): evidence payroll keeps with a result (a signed statement, a calculation sheet). The payslip is People's content host, so the file is never on the person's broadly visible Party record; get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles admit it only to a payroll reader of the slip's employer (mantle.humanres.PayrollResultServices.check#PayslipAccess; the person reads their issued slip, never these files); no Records-drive folder maps it. Written through PayrollResultServices.create#PayslipContent (a payroll editor's).
